title: Association with Núi Bà Đen (Black Virgin Mountain)
description: Larry remembers being on or associated with Núi Bà Đen, the isolated mountain near Tây Ninh, and remembers a Special Forces Sergeant Lowry or Lowery stationed on top. When and in what capacity he was there is an open research question.
larrysRecollection: Larry remembers being on or associated with the mountain. He may have remembered or referred to it as something sounding like "Sun Mountain."
